threat_event: Ransomware encrypts LIS, PACS, and clinic servers and halts diagnostic and clinic operations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: LIS and PACS servers at 23 older sites share a flat management network with clinic workstations
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D1 LIS and PACS; clinic networks
likelihood_basis: EV-046 (flat management network at 23 sites); EV-047 (legacy site patch age); EV-083 (Care Delivery risk interviews)
existing_controls: Group EDR and 24x7 SOC (inherited); immutable backups
treatment_plan: Segment the 23 legacy sites into clinical, device, and user zones; restore test of LIS and PACS each quarter
owner: Care Delivery security and compliance lead

threat_event: Care Delivery PHI on the Group Data Platform is used or exposed beyond its permitted purpose
threat_source: Insider or external attacker using over-broad platform roles
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group Data Platform mixes Care Delivery and Health Plan PHI; purpose-based access is inconsistent; minimum necessary between divisions not verified
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G3 Group Data Platform (Care Delivery zone)
likelihood_basis: EV-025 (mixed zones; tags on 61% of tables); EV-027 (standing roles in both zones)
treatment_plan: Separate Care Delivery and Health Plan zones; attribute-based purpose tags; quarterly minimum-necessary review (group plan GR-01)

threat_event: Workforce member views patient records without a job need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: EHR privacy monitoring alerts reviewed weekly; high alert volume at large sites
likelihood_basis: EV-048 (weekly alert review; high alert volume)
existing_controls: EHR privacy monitoring analytics; sanctions policy
treatment_plan: Tune alert rules; add VIP and employee-as-patient rules at acquired practices

threat_event: AI scribe inserts an error into a clinical note that is signed and later relied on
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Note sampling covers 2% of AI-assisted notes; no error-rate reporting by language
likelihood_basis: EV-057 (2% note sampling); EV-083 (note errors caught in review)
regulatory_driver: N62-R07 (45 CFR 92.210 if suggestion features enabled); N62-R02
existing_controls: Provider signs every note; attestation checkbox
treatment_plan: Raise sampling to 5%; report error rates by language and age group (P10)
owner: Care Delivery chief medical information officer

threat_event: Predictive decision support (sepsis and readmission scores) performs worse for some patient groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor model uses age and sex inputs; no local performance review by subgroup
likelihood_basis: EV-057 (age and sex inputs; no subgroup review)
existing_controls: Clinical decision support committee approves alerts
treatment_plan: Subgroup performance review; document mitigation per tool (P10)
owner: Care Delivery chief medical information officer

threat_event: Attacker exploits unsupported operating systems on imaging modalities and ASC devices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 41 devices run unsupported operating systems; replacement tied to capital cycle
likelihood_basis: EV-045 (41 unsupported devices); EV-047 (modality support status)
existing_controls: Device VLANs at 80% of sites; passive device monitoring
treatment_plan: Complete device VLANs; replace or isolate 41 unsupported devices

threat_event: Compromise of an imaging vendor's remote support channel reaches PACS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two imaging vendors use persistent remote support tunnels
likelihood_basis: EV-051 (two vendors with persistent remote tunnels)
treatment_plan: Move vendor access to the group PAM broker with session recording and just-in-time approval
owner: Care Delivery security and compliance lead

threat_event: EHR vendor hosting outage exceeds the 4-hour RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single hosted EHR instance for all sites
likelihood_basis: EV-051 (single hosted EHR instance; contract RTO 4 hours); EV-079 (Care Delivery BIA interviews)
existing_controls: Vendor DR commitment (RTO 4 h); read-only downtime workstations at every site
treatment_plan: Annual downtime drill at each region; confirm vendor DR test results yearly

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over patient accounts on the patient app
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Patient MFA optional; bot detection limited to the web portal
likelihood_basis: EV-056 (patient MFA optional; bot detection on the web portal only)
treatment_plan: Risk-based MFA for patients; bot management on the mobile API

threat_event: Authorization flaw in the patient-app API exposes another patient's records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: API authorization tests are manual; last third-party test 2025-11
likelihood_basis: EV-056 (manual API authorization tests; last third-party test 2025-11)
existing_controls: Secure development standard; annual penetration test
treatment_plan: Automated object-level authorization tests in the build pipeline

threat_event: Hurricane closes clinic sites and ASCs in coastal states for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Coastal concentration of sites
likelihood_basis: EV-045 (coastal site footprint); EV-050 (continuity plans)
existing_controls: ASC emergency preparedness program; hosted EHR
treatment_plan: Cross-site patient redirection playbook; generator testing log at ASCs

threat_event: Laboratory interface failure delays critical results
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single interface engine cluster per region; alerting on queue depth only during business hours
likelihood_basis: EV-046 (one interface cluster per region; business-hours alerting)
treatment_plan: 24x7 interface monitoring through the group SOC operations bridge

threat_event: Locum and contractor EHR accounts remain active after assignments end
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contractor end dates not fed from the vendor management system
likelihood_basis: EV-006 (contractor end dates entered by hand); EV-037 (locum end dates not sent to HR)
treatment_plan: Feed contractor end dates into identity governance; auto-expire at end date
owner: Care Delivery security and compliance lead

threat_event: Business email compromise of a revenue cycle mailbox redirects payments and exposes PHI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payment change requests verified by email only at 3 regional offices
likelihood_basis: EV-052 (email-only verification at 3 regional offices)
treatment_plan: Call-back verification for bank changes at all offices

threat_event: Release of information staff send records to the wrong requester
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High request volume; manual matching
likelihood_basis: EV-083 (release of information volume and manual matching)
treatment_plan: Automated requester matching in the release-of-information tool

threat_event: Theft of an encrypted clinician laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops used off-site
likelihood_basis: EV-023 (laptop disk encryption); EV-083 (laptop use off-site)
treatment_plan: Accepted: encryption makes the PHI secured; residual risk Low
owner: Care Delivery security and compliance lead

threat_event: Attacker targets the legacy EHR at 14 acquired practices, which lacks group MFA and central logging
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy EHR not federated to SYS-G1; logs not in the group SIEM
likelihood_basis: EV-049 (legacy EHR not federated; logs kept locally)
existing_controls: Local MFA on remote access only
treatment_plan: Interim log forwarding to SIEM by 2026-11-30; migrate to SYS-D1 by 2027-06-30

threat_event: Clinical algorithms with race, age, sex, or disability inputs are used without review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inventory of decision support tools covers the EHR but not specialty applications
likelihood_basis: EV-057 (decision support inventory lists EHR tools only)
treatment_plan: Extend the tool inventory to specialty applications; review input variables
owner: Care Delivery chief medical information officer

threat_event: Visits are recorded by the AI scribe without the consent that state law requires
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consent captured verbally; documentation inconsistent across states
likelihood_basis: EV-057 (verbal consent; documentation varies by state)
regulatory_driver: N62-R02; state recording laws (Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) worked example)
treatment_plan: Mandatory consent field before recording starts; state-by-state consent matrix

threat_event: Ransomware at a claims clearinghouse halts claims and eligibility for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single clearinghouse connection for 85% of claims
likelihood_basis: EV-052 (85% of claims through one clearinghouse)
treatment_plan: Contract and test a second clearinghouse connection; 60-day cash contingency

threat_event: Clinician credentials phished for remote EHR access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Number-matching MFA for workforce; phishing-resistant keys for administrators only
likelihood_basis: EV-005 (number-matching MFA; hardware keys for administrators only); EV-036 (phishing exercises)
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for remote clinician access

threat_event: Network failure at an ASC interrupts surgical scheduling and device data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single core switch at 5 ASCs
likelihood_basis: EV-046 (single core switch at 5 ASCs)
treatment_plan: Redundant core switches at 5 ASCs

threat_event: Imaging studies corrupted in PACS storage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrity checks run weekly
likelihood_basis: EV-048 (weekly PACS integrity checks)
treatment_plan: Daily integrity verification

threat_event: Printed PHI left in clinic areas or discarded in regular trash
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Locked shred bins not present in all exam areas
likelihood_basis: EV-055 (shred bins not in all exam areas); EV-054 (destruction vendor)
treatment_plan: Shred bins in all exam areas; quarterly walkthroughs

threat_event: White-label practices receive no SOC 2 assurance for the patient-app platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No independent assurance report; commitments to 38 practices not yet evidenced
likelihood_basis: EV-056 (white-label agreements; no assurance report)
treatment_plan: SOC 2 Type 2 readiness and first observation period (P09)

threat_event: Revenue cycle employee exports patient lists for identity theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Report-writer rights granted broadly in 2024 migration
likelihood_basis: EV-048 (report-writer rights from the 2024 migration); EV-008 (rights certified as held)
treatment_plan: Remove report-writer rights not needed; alert on bulk exports

threat_event: Denial of service against the patient app
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public endpoints
likelihood_basis: EV-056 (DDoS protection and rate limiting)
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low

threat_event: ASC emergency plans do not cover a prolonged cyber outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plans reviewed in 2025 but cyber scenarios not tested
likelihood_basis: EV-050 (plans reviewed 2025; no cyber scenario drilled)
treatment_plan: Add a cyber outage scenario to the next ASC exercise

threat_event: Guest Wi-Fi at 9 sites is not isolated from clinic networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy site configurations
likelihood_basis: EV-046 (guest Wi-Fi at 9 sites)
treatment_plan: Isolate guest Wi-Fi at 9 sites

threat_event: Patient-app release introduces a vulnerable open-source component
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dependency scanning in place; exceptions not time-limited
likelihood_basis: EV-056 (dependency scanning; exceptions not time-limited)
treatment_plan: Time-limit scan exceptions to 30 days
